newsitem.title: USA: NIMO shuts Nine Mile Pt 2 nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: NIMO shuts Nine Mile Pt 2 nuclear plant.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp said Monday it shut its 1,137 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 2 nuclear unit this morning due to a leak.
The plant was shut at 0714 EDT "due to leakage in the plant's water collection system at a rate slightly above specified limits," the company said in a statement.
An "Unusual Event" was declared at 0728 EDT due to the leak, the company said, but the leak rate has since subsided below unusual event limits.
No further details regarding the unit's restart or cause of the leak were available.

The unit, in Scriba, N.Y., is owned by NIMO (41 percent), New York State Electric and Gas (18 percent), Long Island Lighting Co (18 percent), Rochester Gas and Electric Corp (14 percent) and Central Hudson Gas and Electric Corp (9 percent).
